top_posts.author: Aldebaran_Intelligence
top_posts.text: $APPS this stock was not priced for perfection in the first place, this drop doesn't make any sense, and they just compressed a bit QoQ, but YoY EBITDA rose 46%. It will go back to $10.

top_posts.author: Digitcipher
top_posts.text: $APPS  I thought it was pretty significant that ODS saw 20% growth and ACCELERATING.  Plus they signed another Tier 1 carrier soon after Orange. Wasn't the market crying about sluggish ODS not long ago? This market is maniacal and can't make up it's mind on what is good and what isn't. DT is going in the right direction.

top_posts.author: Digitcipher
top_posts.text: $APPS Amidst all of this, it's a 2nd quarter in a row that ODS comes in strong.  This quarter was +20%, even stronger than last quarter.  That was an unexpected surprise.  Plus now they've signed yet another tier 1 carrier. I think the market is being a little short sighted here. The company has been perfect 8 quarters in a row. This margin hiccup will be short-lived.
